specification: AASHTO LRFD Bridge Design Specifications, 10th Edition

units.note: bearing pad dimensions in inches, G in ksi

abutments.name: Abut. 1

LL.note: LL+IM per girder (kip), per-lane reactions with the lane search of SubLoads; IM included (bridge seat is above ground).

BR.note: Either direction; values are for the direction toward the span.

notes: Unfactored. Forces in kip; lengths in ft unless the name says otherwise.

Vx is + toward the span (toward the toe, the calculator's driving direction); Vy is along the bearing line, + to the left looking ahead station; P is + downward; y is the girder offset along the bearing line from the bridge centerline, + left looking ahead station.
Horizontal forces are already distributed to this abutment by stiffness in SubLoads; the calculator shares are set to 100% and its own BR/TU/CR·SH generators are switched off.
Horizontal row forces are split equally among the girders. Vertical P values under BR, WS, WL, and CE are the overturning couples of those forces.
calculatorInput.rx.WS is the Strength III case with the largest horizontal force (0°, from the left); all cases and limit-state speeds are under loadCases.WS.
calculatorInput.rx.LL is the concurrent set that maximizes the total live load at the bridge seat; per-bearing envelopes are under loadCases.LL.
Earth pressure, soil, and backfill properties are not exported: the abutment calculator computes them.

basis.LL: LL+IM bearing reactions per girder from the SubLoads lane search (all loaded lanes, IM and multiple presence included); not per lane
basis.horizontal: BR, TU, CR/SH, WS, WL, FR, EQ are this abutment's stiffness share, split equally among the girders
basis.signs: P + down; Vx + toward the span (toward the toe); Vy + left looking ahead station; y + left looking ahead station

notes: Unfactored loads in kip; lengths in ft unless the field name says otherwise.
LL+IM values are total bearing reactions per girder with IM and multiple presence already included (not per lane).
Vx is + toward the span (toward the toe); Vy and girder offsets y are + to the left looking ahead station; P is + downward.
Horizontal forces are already this abutment's share (stiffness distribution in SubLoads), split equally among the girders.
Earth pressure, soil and backfill properties are not sent: the abutment calculator computes them.
